# `patches`

the patches of a scalar map at one spatial scale of the surface's grid, with their measurements and summaries.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run patches --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run patches --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run patches --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --map rest_alpha_power --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --sign positive
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `map` | field any, where {"name": "$map"} | yes |
| `surface` | manifold surface, is map.manifold.0 | yes |
| `tiles` | selection set, manifold map.manifold.0 (the surface's grid (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface` first)) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `map` | `--map` | none | - |  | the stored field to find patches in (a scalar per vertex of a surface, every value finite) |
| `spatial_scale` | `--spatial-scale` | none | mm |  | the scale as a quantity: a tile diameter (20 mm), a wavelength (wavelength 40 mm), an eigenvalue or a named scale; its Weyl band is the map's filter, its tiles the partition (resolved to the grid's level in closed form and recorded with the snapped quantity) |
| `sign` | `--sign` | `positive` | - | positive, negative, magnitude | positive (bumps: high values) \| negative (dips) \| magnitude (\|x\|): applied to the tile means before the thresholds |
| `enter_sd` | `--enter-sd` | `1.5` | SD |  | a region must reach median + enter_sd robust SDs (Rheome's hiSD, as band_bursts) |
| `exit_sd` | `--exit-sd` | `1.0` | SD |  | and extends over tiles at median + exit_sd robust SDs (loSD) |
| `min_area` | `--min-area` | none | mm2 |  | the smallest patch kept, as an area; null: none (the caller's size, never an instrument's) |
| `max_area` | `--max-area` | none | mm2 |  | the largest patch kept, as an area; null: none |
| `transform` | `--transform` | `auto` | - |  | the spatial band's transform: auto (eigenmodes first, chebyshev an announced fallback) \| eigen \| chebyshev \| exact |
| `modes` | `--modes` | none | - |  | the eigenmodes made when the package is computed; null: the standard |
| `order` | `--order` | none | - |  | the Chebyshev order; null: from the tolerance |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | none | - |  | the Chebyshev tolerance; null: the default |
| `summaries` | `--summaries` | `["count", "sum", "median", "mean", "sd", "percentile:25", "percentile:75", "percentile:90"]` | - |  | the summaries across the patches |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`select.patch_summaries`](../nodes.md) | map=map, tiles=tiles | spatial_scale=$spatial_scale, sign=$sign, enter_sd=$enter_sd, exit_sd=$exit_sd, min_area=$min_area, max_area=$max_area, transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance, summaries=$summaries | band, tile_measures, baseline, patches, patch_measures, patch_own, area, n_tiles, mean, peak |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `band` | kind field, kind_name map, name {map}_band_${spatial_scale}, on map.manifold.0 |
| `tile_measures` | kind measurement, over tiles, of band |
| `baseline` | kind statistic, name {map}_band_${spatial_scale}_baseline, of band, over tiles, axes [{"name": "row"}, {"name": "summary"}] |
| `patches` | kind selection, type set, name {map} patches ${spatial_scale} ${sign}, on map.manifold.0 |
| `patch_measures` | kind measurement, over patches, of band |
| `patch_own` | kind measurement, name {map}_patches_${spatial_scale}_${sign}_own, over patches |
| `area` | kind statistic, name {map}_patches_${spatial_scale}_${sign}_area, of band, over patches, axes [{"name": "row"}, {"name": "summary"}] |
| `n_tiles` | kind statistic, name {map}_patches_${spatial_scale}_${sign}_n_tiles, of band, over patches, axes [{"name": "row"}, {"name": "summary"}] |
| `mean` | kind statistic, name {map}_patches_${spatial_scale}_${sign}_mean, of band, over patches, axes [{"name": "row"}, {"name": "summary"}] |
| `peak` | kind statistic, name {map}_patches_${spatial_scale}_${sign}_peak, of band, over patches, axes [{"name": "row"}, {"name": "summary"}] |

## Notes from the definition

```text
PATCHES ON A STATIC CORTICAL MAP: where a scalar map on a surface has regions above its own baseline, at one scale (a quantity). The map is filtered to the level's Weyl band (the band, a field); the band's
mean (area-weighted by the vertices' barycentric areas), max, min and abs_max are measured per tile of the level; the median and the robust SD (1.4826 MAD) of the tile means are the baseline;
the regions of the signed tile means reaching median + enter_sd SDs, extended over the tiles at median + exit_sd SDs (hysteresis over the tile graph: tiles joined by a mesh edge, hemispheres never
touch) are the patches (a set selection on the surface: code = the patch's ordinal, by its lowest tile); the band's values over the patches, the patches' own measures (area, tiles, centre vertex)
and the summaries across the patches of area, tiles, mean and peak follow. It builds no instrument limit into the detection (min_area and max_area are the caller's, named) and it does not merge
patches that do not touch. The surface's ladder comes first (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface`).

  nxr-neuro run patches --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --map rest_alpha_power --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --sign positive
```
